calls.statement:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 1 AS first_week, 4 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    CROSS JOIN params
    CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id || '-' || d.fiscal_week) AS store_weeks, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id) AS stores
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY d.fiscal_year
)
SELECT ty.fiscal_year, ty.stores, ty.store_weeks, ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales ty CROSS JOIN params
JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year

calls.statement:
WITH mine AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS v
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
), m AS (
  SELECT business_date, store_id, SUM(v) AS mine FROM mine GROUP BY 1,2
), c AS (
  SELECT business_date, store_id, net_sales AS ctrl FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id < 900
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, COUNT(*) AS store_days, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(m.mine,0)),2) AS mine, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(c.ctrl,0)),2) AS ctrl,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(COALESCE(m.mine,0)-COALESCE(c.ctrl,0))>0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mismatched_days
FROM m FULL JOIN c USING (business_date, store_id)
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = COALESCE(m.business_date, c.business_date)
WHERE (d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' OR d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 4
GROUP BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_year,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_date x WHERE x.fiscal_year=d.fiscal_year AND x.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 4 AND NOT x.is_trading_day) AS closed_days,
       (SELECT string_agg(x.holiday_name || ' ' || CAST(x.calendar_date AS VARCHAR), ', ') FROM dim_date x WHERE x.fiscal_year=d.fiscal_year AND x.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 4 AND NOT x.is_trading_day) AS closed_list,
       COUNT(*) AS lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id::VARCHAR || '-' || f.line_no) AS distinct_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS distinct_ids,
       MIN(f.etl_loaded_at) AS min_load, MAX(f.etl_loaded_at) AS max_load
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 4
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year

WITH x AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, s.store_id, s.store_name, SUM(f.net_amount) AS v, COUNT(DISTINCT d.fiscal_week) AS wks
  FROM (SELECT sale_date, store_key, product_key, net_amount FROM fact_sales_line) f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 4
  GROUP BY 1,2,3
)
SELECT a.store_id, a.store_name, a.v AS ty, b.v AS ly, a.wks AS ty_wks, b.wks AS ly_wks, ROUND(100.0*(a.v/b.v-1),1) AS g
FROM x a FULL JOIN x b ON a.store_id=b.store_id AND b.fiscal_year='FY2025/26'
WHERE a.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' OR a.fiscal_year IS NULL
ORDER BY g
